entries.claim: Mimo's own cross-tool cost-per-unit and cost-crossover calculation (computed 2026-09-19), derived entirely from three already-registered, dated vendor pricing captures (EV-surfer-seo-review-01, captured 2026-07-16; EV-neuronwriter-review-01, captured 2026-07-13; EV-frase-review-01, captured 2026-07-20) and treating one NeuronWriter 'analysis', one Surfer 'document', and one Frase 'article' as equivalent to one optimized article (the same simplifying convention already published on the live /vs/neuronwriter-vs-surfer-seo page for two of the three tools): NeuronWriter is the cheapest total monthly bill up to roughly 50 articles/month (Bronze-Silver, $23-45), Surfer's flat-rate Discovery tier ($49, covering up to 120 documents) overtakes it just above 50/month and stays cheapest through at least 150/month, and Frase is the most expensive option at every tested volume above roughly 10 articles/month, with a severe pricing cliff between its Professional tier (40 articles for $129) and Scale tier (100 articles for $299) that a reader hitting 41 articles/month would fall directly into. This is MIMO'S OWN ARITHMETIC, not a third-party finding, test, or vendor claim — no independent published source performs this three-way calculation, and 0 of 10 competitor pages audited in Data/seo/phases/best-ai-seo-writing-tools/1-competitor.json compute any per-article cost math for any tool.
